description: This file defines the ContentTypesAdminNodeDriver class, a display driver for managing content type nodes in OrchardCore, including display, editing, and updating content type nodes with authorization checks.

classes.name: ContentTypesAdminNodeDriver
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from DisplayDriver, responsible for rendering, editing, and updating content type nodes in OrchardCore's admin UI.

methods.name: ContentTypesAdminNodeDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for content definition management, HTTP context access, and authorization.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously renders the display view for a ContentTypesAdminNode, including tree summary and thumbnail.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editing view model for a ContentTypesAdminNode, populating it with available content types.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to a ContentTypesAdminNode based on user input, updating its properties and content types.

methods.name: GetListableContentTypeDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and filters content type definitions that the current user is authorized to list, ordered by display name.
